MARIO CALCULATOR — BUTTON GUIDE
── MEMORY BUTTONS ────────────────── MC Memory Clear Resets the stored memory value to 0.
MR Memory Recall Loads the memory value into the display.
M− Memory Subtract Subtracts the current display value from memory.
M+ Memory Add Adds the current display value to memory.
── CLEAR BUTTONS ──────────────────── C Clear All Resets the current calculation entirely.
CE Clear Entry Clears the last number entered, keeping any pending operator.
── NUMBER BUTTONS ─────────────────── 0–9 Enter digits. 00 Enter double zero shortcut. . Decimal point.
── OPERATOR BUTTONS ───────────────── + Addition − Subtraction × Multiplication ÷ Division % Percentage After typing a number, press % to convert it to a percentage of the previous value (or divide by 100 if standalone).
= Equals — compute the result.
── NAVIGATION ─────────────────────── Unit Converter Convert between units of length, weight, temperature, area, volume, and speed.
Help Display this help screen.
Exit Close the application.
── HISTORY ────────────────────────── Each completed calculation is logged in the HISTORY panel at the top of the screen.
── MEMORY DISPLAY ─────────────────── The MEMORY value is shown at the top right. It persists across calculations until MC is pressed.
